h1: The 5 Best 24-Inch Monitor Privacy Screens of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 5 best 24 inch monitor privacy screens, from 3M optical film to magnetic 2-packs, compared on attachment and price.
summary: The 3M Privacy Filter with Comply magnetic attachment is our top 24 inch pick for easy on and off use. The standard 3M filter uses genuine 3M optical film, the Peslv 2-Pack covers two monitors, and the generic single filter is the budget choice.
intro: Many 24 inch privacy filters look identical in photos, yet they differ in how they mount and whether the film is a branded optical product. The expensive mistake is a filter that fits a 16:9 screen but is awkward to remove, so you leave it on during every screen share.
We ranked five 24 inch, 16:9 filters on film brand, attachment style and pack size from their listings. Two come from 3M, which states its optical film, while the others state size and pack count.

products.name: 3M Privacy Filter for 24in Full Screen Monitor with 3M Comply Magnetic Attach
products.verdict: 3M filter with a magnetic attachment you can pop off.
products.description:
This 3M filter fits a 24 inch full screen monitor and uses 3M Comply magnetic attachment, with a price in the $50-100 bucket.

Top spot goes to it because a named brand and a magnetic mount are the most convenient combination here. The tradeoff is that only one filter is included.

Best for a single desk where you share your screen sometimes. The caveat is that it covers one monitor only.
products.idealFor: Single-monitor desks that share their screen.
products.skipIf: You need two filters in one buy.

products.name: 3M Privacy Filters for 24 Inch Widescreen Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: Genuine 3M optical film for a 24 inch widescreen.
products.description:
The 3M filter for 24 inch widescreen monitors lists genuine 3M optical film at 16:9, priced in the $50-100 bucket.

It follows the magnetic model because it lacks the stated Comply mount, though it keeps the brand's film. The tradeoff is less convenience.

Best for buyers who value the film brand. The caveat is that the attachment type is not given.
products.idealFor: Buyers who prefer branded optical film.

products.name: Peslv [2-Pack] 24 Inch Privacy Screen for Computer Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: Two removable 24 inch filters for a dual setup.
products.description:
Peslv ships two 24 inch, 16:9 removable filters in one pack, and the cost lands at $50 to $100.

Third place fits, since you give up a named film but gain a second filter for a similar price. The tradeoff is brand assurance.

Best for dual-monitor desks. The caveat is that the film is unbranded in the listing.
products.skipIf: You prefer a named brand film.

products.name: 2 Pack 24 Inch Magnetic Computer Privacy Screen for Monitor, 16:9 Aspect Ratio
products.verdict: Two magnetic filters if you want quick removal on two screens.
products.description:
This 2-pack has magnetic attachment for 24 inch, 16:9 monitors and is priced in the $50-100 bucket.

It sits fourth because the magnet system is not branded the way the 3M Comply mount is. The tradeoff is the unknown magnet quality.

Best for two monitors with frequent sharing. The caveat is the lack of a named film or mount brand.

products.name: Computer Privacy Screen Filter for 24 Inch 16:9 Aspect Ratio Monitor
products.verdict: The cheapest single 24 inch filter in this ranking.
products.description:
This is a single 24 inch, 16:9 privacy screen filter that costs $25 to $50.

Last place is where it lands since it names no brand, attachment or film, but it costs less than the others. The tradeoff is documentation.

Best for a low-cost single monitor. The caveat is that very little is stated beyond size.

whatMatters.detail: A 24 inch label means the screen diagonal, and 16:9 is the shape. A mismatch leaves gaps. Check your monitor's specs and the listing.
A named optical film like 3M's has a clear source. Unnamed film is harder to judge. Look for the film name in the title.
Magnetic mounts snap off, while others stay fixed. Pick based on how often you share your screen. Look for magnetic or removable in the listing.
Two filters cover two monitors. Buying a single when you have two means a second order. Check the pack count.
Filters range from $25-50 to $50-100. Paying more mostly buys brand and mount. Check the live price.

faq.q: Will these fit a 24 inch monitor of any shape?
faq.a: They are listed for 16:9. If your 24 inch monitor has a different ratio, check before buying.
Buying a fixed filter, then leaving it on during every screen share. A magnetic one avoids that.

faq.q: Is 3M worth it over the generic filter?
faq.a: If you want named optical film and a magnetic mount, yes. If cost matters most, the generic single is cheaper.

faq.q: How do I install a magnetic filter?
faq.a: Follow the listing instructions. The 3M Comply system is designed for attach and remove.

faq.q: Can I use one on a different size?
faq.a: No. Each is listed for 24 inch screens only.

faq.q: Does the 3M widescreen filter attach magnetically?
faq.a: The listing does not say, so check the product page.

finalTake: The 3M Comply magnetic filter is the best 24 inch privacy screen here for single monitors. The standard 3M filter keeps the optical film, the Peslv 2-Pack covers a dual setup, and the generic single is the cheapest. Confirm aspect ratio first.
